lean.plain: Bound the covolume by slope comparisons
lean.note: To bound the normalised log covolume from above, the proof bounds the slope of the sublattice cut out by the orthogonal idempotent from below. The exponentially small rank share of the omitted summand controls the cost of the comparison with the full lattice.
